headline: Windlas Biotech appoints Aashish Mehra and Soni Saran Singh as independent directors
summary: Windlas Biotech has announced the appointment of Aashish Mehra and Soni Saran Singh to its board as independent directors. The company's routine corporate governance update brings in new oversight. Such board changes are procedural filings for listed pharmaceutical firms. Retail investors can note the management updates without major portfolio impact.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact.
